## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces`

Create a namespace

Needs `CREATE_NAMESPACE`. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 409 when the namespace exists.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `NamespaceCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | text | yes |  |
| `properties` | mapping of text to text | no |  |
| `break_glass_reason` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `NamespaceOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `NamespaceOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | text | yes |  |
| `properties` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces`

List the namespaces of an environment

Lists the namespaces of the environment at every depth, not only the top level, in the order of their path parts. Needs `READ_NAMESPACE` on the environment. Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and 422 for a `depth` other than 1 or a cursor this list did not issue. The cursor of the next page is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header and is absent on the last page.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `parent` | query | no | text or null | Dot-joined path; only the namespaces below it, at every depth (the parent itself is left out). |
| `depth` | query | no | whole number or null | ``1`` keeps only the direct children of `parent`, or the top-level namespaces without one. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most namespaces returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `X-Next-Cursor` of the previous page; send the same `parent` and `depth`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `NamespaceOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `DELETE /api/v1/environments/{env}/namespaces/{path}`

Drop a namespace

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Needs `DROP_NAMESPACE`. Answers 404 when the namespace does not exist and 409 while it still holds tables or child namespaces.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `path` | path | yes | text | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `break_glass_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why the protection of a protected environment is broken, up to 500 characters; recorded in the audit log. Only a protected environment needs it. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Successful Response | none |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |
